nonblocking_observations.title: Preserve the distinction between outer success and controls transfer
nonblocking_observations.detail: After array import,1cc71e calls1d83b0. Nonzero AL takes the1cc72a success return without reaching ReadSimCtrl or the unit setter. Earlier errors also return before transfer, sometimes after storage clear. The contract is acceptable as G1 transfer semantics, but success of1cc420 must not be used as evidence that G1 ran.
nonblocking_observations.followup: Capture helper entry/exit and setter occurrence separately from outer return. Document/resolve the1d83b0 gate when integrating the outer pipeline; no need to broaden this static review.

nonblocking_observations.title: Make prestate and read extents explicit in future fixtures
nonblocking_observations.detail: G1-T10 type7c needs an allocated axis element under its inherited shape; G1-T12 count0/1 still traverses21 child keys. A positive directory length alone does not bound the bytes consumed. Existing U2/U4 acknowledge this; fixture authors must convert those qualifications into concrete preconditions.
nonblocking_observations.followup: Use distinct seeded metadata/scalars and payload markers; provide directory terminators and payload extents for actual traversal/shape, not merely requested count. Keep malformed-memory behavior excluded.
